title: Schedule of Enrollment Types: Admission, Campus Assignment and Selection — Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions
content:
This schedule to the district's enrollment policy sets out, for each of the seven enrollment types of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, which students the type admits, how the campus is decided and how placements are allotted. Every enrollment record of a student for a school year carries exactly one of these types.

## Who each type admits

| Enrollment type | Kind of enrollment | Grade levels admitted | The type admits a student when |
|---|---|---|---|
| Attendance Zone Enrollment | zone | KG and grades 01 through 12 | the campus is the student's zoned campus and the household profile shows an in-district residence |
| Intra-District Transfer (Space Available) | intra-district transfer | KG and grades 01 through 12 | the household profile shows an in-district residence and an approved space-available transfer request is on file |
| Intra-District Transfer (Employee Child) | intra-district transfer | KG and grades 01 through 12 | the household profile is flagged as a district employee household and an approved employee-child transfer request is on file |
| Non-Resident Transfer | non-resident transfer | KG and grades 01 through 12 | the household profile shows no in-district residence and an approved non-resident transfer request is on file |
| Choice Program Enrollment | choice program | KG and grades 01 through 12 | the household profile shows an in-district residence and an approved choice-program request is on file |
| Pre-Kindergarten (State-Eligible) | prekindergarten | PK3 and PK4 | a state Pre-K eligibility basis is on file and the household profile shows an in-district residence |
| Pre-Kindergarten (Tuition-Based) | prekindergarten | PK4 only | the household profile shows an in-district residence |

## Campus, request and household requirements

| Enrollment type | How the campus is decided | Approved transfer request for the same school year required | Transfer request category leading to the type | In-district residence required | District employee household flag required |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Attendance Zone Enrollment | attendance zone (the student's zoned campus) | no | not applicable | yes | no |
| Intra-District Transfer (Space Available) | approved transfer request (the requested campus of the approved request) | yes | space available | yes | no |
| Intra-District Transfer (Employee Child) | approved transfer request (the requested campus of the approved request) | yes | employee child | no | yes |
| Non-Resident Transfer | approved transfer request (the requested campus of the approved request) | yes | non-resident | no | no |
| Choice Program Enrollment | program admission (the campus of the admitted program) | yes | choice program | yes | no |
| Pre-Kindergarten (State-Eligible) | attendance zone (the student's zoned campus) | no | not applicable | yes | no |
| Pre-Kindergarten (Tuition-Based) | attendance zone (the student's zoned campus) | no | not applicable | yes | no |

## How placements are allotted

| Enrollment type | Selection method | Programs admitted under the type (program and campus) | Campuses closed to new placements of the type for the school year |
|---|---|---|---|
| Attendance Zone Enrollment | zone assignment | none | none |
| Intra-District Transfer (Space Available) | first come, space available | none | Live Oak Elementary; Calloway Creek High School |
| Intra-District Transfer (Employee Child) | first come, space available | none | none |
| Non-Resident Transfer | first come, space available | none | Live Oak Elementary; Calloway Creek High School |
| Choice Program Enrollment | lottery | Two-Way Dual Language Program at Bluebonnet Trail Elementary; STEM Academy at Ridgecrest Middle School; Early College High School at Mesquite Ridge High School | none |
| Pre-Kindergarten (State-Eligible) | eligibility verification | none | none |
| Pre-Kindergarten (Tuition-Based) | first come, space available | none | none |

## Notes on reading the schedule

- "In-district residence required" means the household profile must show an in-district residence; "district employee household flag required" means the household profile must be flagged as a district employee household.
- A closed campus takes no new placement of that type for the school year; the list is per type, so Live Oak Elementary and Calloway Creek High School are closed to space-available and non-resident placements but not to employee-child placements.
- Pre-Kindergarten (Tuition-Based) admits PK4 children only; a PK3 child can be admitted to Pre-K only on Pre-Kindergarten (State-Eligible).
